intro.speaker: ALIEN
intro.speech: Va resh. Nara vekh tala. Ish ven nar.
intro.caption: ALIEN: Va resh. Nara vekh tala. Ish ven nar. [untranslated Narcean]

intro.speaker: JASON
intro.speech: Hello? Can you understand me? My name is Jason.
intro.caption: JASON: Hello? Can you understand me? My name is Jason.

intro.speaker: ORAC
intro.speech: He's speaking Narcean. I'll send him an English language sample. Jason. Human. English.
intro.caption: ORAC: He's speaking Narcean. I'll send him an English language sample. Jason. Human. English.

intro.speaker: ALIEN
intro.speech: Zha. Jay son. English. One moment. I appear to have put the verbs somewhere.
intro.caption: ALIEN: Zha... Jay-son. English. One moment. I appear to have put the verbs somewhere.

intro.speaker: ALIEN
intro.speech: There. English. You may call me Alien. You are early. Or extraordinarily late. My calendar has become decorative.
intro.caption: ALIEN: There. English. You may call me Alien. You're early. Or extraordinarily late. My calendar has become decorative.

intro.speaker: JASON
intro.speech: You don't know us. Why are you helping?
intro.caption: JASON: You don't know us. Why are you helping?

intro.speaker: ALIEN
intro.speech: Your face. You look like the people who met here. The resistance. I think. I remember faces better than dates. Although some of the faces may have been chairs.
intro.caption: ALIEN: Your face. You look like the people who met here. The resistance. I think. I remember faces better than dates. Although some of the faces may have been chairs.

intro.speaker: ORAC
intro.speech: We're not members of your resistance. Jason and I only just found this place.
intro.caption: ORAC: We're not members of your resistance. Jason and I only just found this place.

intro.speaker: ALIEN
intro.speech: Well, you asked instead of issuing orders. And your companion is allowed to disagree. That used to be quite a radical arrangement. You needn't join anything. I can choose to help.
intro.caption: ALIEN: Well, you asked instead of issuing orders. And your companion is allowed to disagree. That used to be quite a radical arrangement. You needn't join anything. I can choose to help.

intro.speaker: ALIEN
intro.speech: I kept this room ready for them. After a while I stopped expecting anyone. Then I stopped noticing when a while had passed. It's rather nice to be useful to someone who answers.
intro.caption: ALIEN: I kept this room ready for them. After a while I stopped expecting anyone. Then I stopped noticing when a while had passed. It's rather nice to be useful to someone who answers.

intro.speaker: ALIEN
intro.speech: You gave me English. I can give your companion Narcean. Service scripts, grammar, the local vocabulary. Sending it now. Do keep a copy. I have mislaid entire centuries.
intro.caption: ALIEN: You gave me English. I can give your companion Narcean. Service scripts, grammar, the local vocabulary. Sending it now. Do keep a copy. I've mislaid entire centuries.

intro.speaker: ORAC
intro.speech: Received. Now I can translate the service writing for you, Jason. Those recording labels are song titles. I couldn't read them before.
intro.caption: ORAC: Received. Now I can translate the service writing for you, Jason. Those recording labels are song titles. I couldn't read them before.

intro.speaker: JASON
intro.speech: What is this room? Does that stepping pad still work?
intro.caption: JASON: What is this room? Does that stepping pad still work?

intro.speaker: ALIEN
intro.speech: Private meetings. I kept the room ready. The stepping pad goes to the surface launch dock. I'll restore the link. There. It works. I am less certain about the dock.
intro.caption: ALIEN: Private meetings. I kept the room ready. The pad goes to the surface launch dock. I'll restore the link. There. It works. I'm less certain about the dock.

intro.speaker: ORAC
intro.speech: We can check it ourselves. Jason, stand on the pad and press F.
intro.caption: ORAC: We can check it ourselves. Jason, stand on the pad and press F.

repeat.speaker: ALIEN
repeat.speech: I used to coordinate all the meetings. Now I coordinate the chairs. They are much more punctual.
repeat.caption: ALIEN: I used to coordinate all the meetings. Now I coordinate the chairs. They're much more punctual.

repeat.speaker: ALIEN
repeat.speech: The pad is behind you. I'll make sure the link is active. There. Stand on it and use the control. I have left the return link open. I do occasionally finish things.
repeat.caption: ALIEN: The pad is behind you. I'll make sure the link is active. There. Stand on it and use the control. I've left the return link open. I do occasionally finish things.

returned.speaker: JASON
returned.speech: The dock is destroyed. I don't think they made it.
returned.caption: JASON: The dock is destroyed. I don't think they made it.

returned.speaker: ALIEN
returned.speech: There were people waiting to leave.
returned.caption: ALIEN: There were people waiting to leave.

returned.speaker: ALIEN
returned.speech: I remember keeping the room ready.
returned.caption: ALIEN: I remember keeping the room ready.
